# Contributing to Autonym

Thanks for taking the time to help improve Autonym.

## Getting started

See the [README](../README.md) for how to run the app from source and build a Windows installer.

## Before opening a pull request

- `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` should both pass.
- Keep changes focused — a bug fix doesn't need to become a refactor, and a new feature doesn't
  need to touch unrelated code.
- If you're adding a new IPC handler or shared function, a quick test alongside it is appreciated
  but not required for small fixes.

## Reporting bugs or requesting features

Please use the issue templates — they help capture the details needed to act on a report quickly.

## Questions

There's no dedicated support channel yet — open an issue and tag it as a question.
